sn15.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Tatra kho || || Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro pubbākoṭi napaññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || Yaṃ bhikkhave passeyyātha duggataṃ durūpetaṃ niṭṭham ettha gantabbam Amhehi pi evarūpaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ iminā dīghena addhunā ti || || Taṃ kissa hetu || || Anamataggāyaṃ bhikkhave {saṃsāro} || pe|| || alaṃ vimuccitunti || || Pathamaṃ || ||
